name: Himegami Nemesia
source: Dahlia Himegami and Elmes Himegami’s mother, as well as the director of Yuriai Private Academy. She utilizes the skills she used to raise two of the “Four Princesses” in her own beauty, which is truly overwhelming. She kindly advises Erika, who is aiming for the title of one of the “Four Princesses,” but she can never grasp the meaning.
